name: The Scott Arms
accommodation: Four en suite double rooms above the pub
dogs: Dogs welcome in the bars and garden (rooms not stated)
confirmedFeatures: Four en suite doubles, locally sourced breakfasts, dog-friendly bars and garden
overview: A pub in the Purbeck village of Kingston, near Corfe Castle, with four en suite double rooms upstairs. It sits in the heart of Purbeck walking country, a short drive across the hills from Kimmeridge Bay.
surfTripFit: A cosy inland base with food and a bar on site, within a short drive of the Kimmeridge reefs.
